scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: sh -c 'npm run test -w apps/server -- "$@" && npm run test -w apps/web' --
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n frontend,backend -c green,blue "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check:server && npm run type-check:web
